messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem (KV eviction). We should convert findings into small, testable artifacts: a targeted regression test set, a compact eval promptset, a short high-impact load spike, and one chaos drill. Proposing owners below.

omar: I'll take the regression tests. Plan: `tests/kv_eviction_minimal/` with 6 deterministic cases that reproduce the eviction pattern. I'll add a README and a local run command. ETA: 04/05.

samir: I'll produce a compact promptset (EVAL-501) focusing on long-prefix chains, streaming truncation, and repeat tokens. Will include golden outputs + fuzzy thresholds. ETA: 04/04, run eval 04/06.

dina_oncall: I'll schedule a short k6 spike (15m at 1.5x burst) and a one-node kill chaos drill in staging. Tentative slot 04/07 09:00 PT. I'll post the checklist in #eng-oncall.

qa-jen: I'll wire up a CI job `kv-evict-check` that runs on PR and nightly. Will block merges on failures and surface flaky flags. Need Omar's test filenames and Samir's golden outputs to finish gating. ETA: 04/06.

incident-bot: created TASK-PLAT-980: "kv eviction minimal regression + gating" assigned to omar.

nina: Owners recap for PM-FU-5100: omar -> minimal regression (TASK-PLAT-980), samir -> promptset & golden outputs (EVAL-501), dina_oncall -> load & chaos (TASK-OPS-630), qa-jen -> CI gating. Weekly check-ins until closed. Add PR links to the follow-up ticket when opened.

samir: One small note: include both token-level and sequence-level scoring; sequence fuzzing at 85% for noisy cases.

omar: I'll add a tiny smoke curl to validate cache warming post-deploy. Example: `curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"kv_warm_1"}'` and include in pre-deploy.

qa-jen: :thumbsup: I'll watch the first few runs for flakiness and loop infra if k6 hits limits.

dina_oncall: I'll post the exact staging slot and runbook in #eng-oncall by EOD.

nina: Thanks everyone. I'll own PM-FU-5100 and run weekly check-ins until everything is green. Closing thread unless blockers.
